summary: Verified Documents page equal-height grid layout fix on both desktop (1920x800) and mobile (390x844). All 16 cards rendered in the 'All' filter and 3 cards in the 'Meetings' filter show identical heights (239px, diff=0.00px) within their rows, and 'View / Download' buttons align at identical bottom Y positions (diff=0.00px). Grid computed style confirms 'display: grid', gridTemplateColumns='682px 682px' (2 cols on desktop) and '308px' (1 col on mobile), grid-auto-rows='minmax(0px, 1fr)'. No horizontal overflow at either viewport. Long titles (e.g. 'KPI Data Sharing - User Guide.docx') fit in 1-2 lines and never exceed the line-clamp-2 (offsetH==scrollH). Regression: search 'KPI' returns 2 matching cards, category filters (all/meetings) work, View/Download links point to /api/files/<id> for uploaded docs.

issues: Minor: one seed document ('Reunion Packet' - document-0) has a View/Download link with href='#' (dead link) because no file was uploaded. Not part of this fix's scope but worth flagging as a UX gap - either hide the button or disable it when no file is attached.

critical_code_review_comments: Documents.jsx equal-height fix is correctly implemented via 'grid auto-rows-fr md:grid-cols-2', card 'h-full flex flex-col', 'mt-auto' on action row, and line-clamp-2 on title/description with min-h reservation on description. Verified via getBoundingClientRect.
Minor UX: 'View / Download' button on documents with no attached file (e.g., Reunion Packet) currently links to '#' - consider disabling or hiding when link is unavailable.
